slug: 2026-01-28 Central African Republic Data Protection Factsheet

facts.fact: Data Protection Africa (ALT Advisory) states in its factsheet that the Central African Republic has a data protection law in place.
facts.system: Loi n° 24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Data Protection Africa (ALT Advisory) states the data protection authority has not yet been appointed, as of 28 January 2026.
facts.system: Loi n° 24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

systems.system: Loi n° 24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The promulgated text of Loi n° 24.001 on personal data protection, adopted mid-January 2024, is held; the document gives no commencement date and no compliance period (date is the published date, month precision).
facts.system: Loi n° 24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Article 57 gives the ministry in charge of the digital economy twelve months from promulgation to set up the data protection agency, and meanwhile vests the agency's missions in that ministry; the text names no composition, seat or financing.
facts.system: Loi n° 24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

note: Article 58 provides for an implementing decree; no regulation is stated as issued; no application is stated.

facts.fact: Jurist Zengue writes the law is promulgated and applied, with a compliance period prescribed and no suspension of the law meanwhile.
Jurist Zengue writes the law names the agency and gives it powers but does not organise it, and provides an interim arrangement for its non-functioning.
The World Bank ISR says the law on the protection of personal data was adopted in January 2024 and the enactment of two laws (cybersecurity and data protection) was achieved in 2024.
facts.system: Law on the protection of personal data

facts.fact: The World Bank ISR says activities are being planned to support drafting of the implementing decrees of the enacted data protection law.
facts.system: Law on the protection of personal data

note: Only a stated priority to harmonise data protection laws; no law or draft stated.
The document gives budget lines and activity titles for CAF, but states no delivered system, rule or figure that answers this study's questions.
Only a passing mention that a personal data protection law was adopted two weeks earlier, with no detail.

facts.fact: ACTPOL says Law No. 24.001 of 25 January 2024 gave the digital economy ministry 12 months to establish a supervisory agency, and in January 2026 it was unclear whether an authority had been appointed.
The article says the country has a legal framework on personal data protection and cybersecurity, without naming a law or date.

facts.fact: ICASEES's draft data dissemination policy, validated at a workshop on 24-25 November 2026, is stated to conform to law no. 24.001 on personal data protection, which it applies as existing law.
